verdict.rationale: Rippling explicitly documents that approved hours from Time & Attendance flow instantly into Payroll with no manual syncing, and that it automatically applies correct overtime/labor policies by location and flags risks before payroll runs, matching the story of hourly entries and overtime flowing into the payroll run. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of overtime specifically hitting a live payroll run, and no detail on how hourly wage calculations reconcile with pay stubs.
